We’re happy to see more businesses embracing #EWAbyPaidHR as a flexible financial benefit for their employees!

To keep the conversation going, we’re launching a new series where we’ll answer all your questions about how Earned Wage Access (EWA) works, especially on PaidHR.

It might seem risky to employers at first, but it’s not. EWA isn’t a loan or a gamble; it’s simply giving employees access to money they’ve already earned so it adds no risk to your business.

Got questions about #EWAbyPaidHR? Drop them in the comments!

In the meantime, check out our blog post to learn more: https://t.co/MY2GwDlmA4

rows.author: getPaidHR
rows.text:
You’ve heard the news. 

We’ve raised $1.8 million in seed funding! 🚀

From an idea on a whiteboard to a platform supporting thousands of workers across Nigeria, Kenya, and South Africa, it’s been quite the ride.

This raise, led by Accion Venture Lab with backing from our returning investors, helps us do what we do best:

- Build better tools.
- Offer smarter financial support.
- Help African teams work and live better.

To every business that’s trusted us and every employee that’s used PaidHR, this win is yours too. 💙

This is our next chapter. And we’re bringing you along.

🔗 Read the full story, from our side: https://t.co/01VnWF5oJO
